title: Monomind
description: A local-first personal knowledge base that imports AI conversations (ChatGPT exports), generates embeddings for semantic search, and uses RAG with citation-backed answers from your conversation history. Features anonymous multi-user isolation via UUID cookies — zero auth required.
features: LanceDB vector storage with cosine similarity search
RAG chat with [N] citations linking to source messages
Structured notes: summary, topics, decisions, open questions
Anonymous multi-user isolation (UUID cookie, row-level security)
Awwards-style UI with animated navbar, SVG logo, page transitions
architecture: import → persist (PostgreSQL) → chunk → embed (Ollama) → vector index (LanceDB) → semantic search → RAG + citations → notes
